scope: Independent whole-object semantic review of frozen N05-B03 v4 only; not source or full-bank acceptance

method.perOptionChecks: The key resolves to one option; the three feedback targets equal the wrong-option IDs; feedback and explanation diagnose the visible misconception.
method.beforeComparison: All 17 question IDs and the B03 copy/prototype objective remain aligned with their before objects; keyed answer IDs are fresh.

structuralReceipt.use: Corroborating 17-question/136-score-case structure only; not used as semantic acceptance.

qualityAssessment.promptDisclosure: The v4 stems present requirements instead of prescribing the copy policy. i001 explicitly requires the same registered asset objects, not only equal IDs/values.
qualityAssessment.plausibleAlternatives: Each item presents concrete competing mistakes such as aliasing mutable state, replacing required shared identity, carrying prior identity/history, or discarding configured state; keyed diagnostics are aligned.

lengthCue.finding: No systematic longest-is-correct cue in the current choices; these counts are not a threshold.

qualityAssessment.reasonAndDetails: Reasons state the deciding copy boundary; all five Details fields apply it, diagnose the nearest error, and describe a boundary. No key-paraphrase defect found.
qualityAssessment.sources: Scenario premises are authored facts. Design Patterns and Fowler Making Stubs provide general design context; no scenario-specific guarantee or external API claim depends on them.
qualityAssessment.duplicateAssessment: The repeated shared-reference/local-state rule is practice within the copy-semantics unit. Items use different object relationships and decisive state boundaries; no same-facts/same-action duplicate found.

limits: No source activation, producer proof, app consumer, admission, native/Premium eligibility, or full BIZQ-01 closure is claimed.
